newsitem.title: USA: Campbell to leave public finance at First Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Campbell to leave public finance at First Chicago.

text.p: Thomas Campbell, the former head of public finance at First Chicago Capital Markets, will leave the public finance staff, a spokesman for First Chicago NBD said Tuesday.

Tom Kelly, the spokesman, said that while Campbell is leaving public finance at a yet-to-be-determined date, it was not clear whether he would remain at First Chicago or would be taking a job somewhere else.
Campbell had headed public finance up until December, when the department was combined with public banking under Jacqueline Hurlbutt, a senior vice president, Kelly said.
